intro.title: Make Every Contribution Count, Again and Again
body: Many organisations depend on ongoing contributions to support their projects, programmes and communities. Managing these regular payments manually can create additional administrative work.

Donorfit helps organisations organise recurring payment activities through its available payment integrations, making it easier to manage ongoing contributions and maintain consistent fundraising programmes.

steps.title: A Simple Way to Manage Recurring Contributions
steps.sub: How online recurring donations and contributions work, from the first choice to ongoing management.

items.title: Choose a contribution
items.text: A donor or supporter selects an available recurring contribution option, where supported.

items.title: Select the payment schedule
items.text: Choose an available recurring interval, such as monthly or annual, as supported by the payment integration.

items.title: Authorise the payment
items.text: The supporter completes the required payment authorisation through the selected payment provider, for example a direct debit mandate.

items.title: Manage ongoing payments
items.text: Recurring payment processing follows the provider’s supported schedule and authorisation rules. Your organisation manages the available recurring payment information in Donorfit.

faq.title: Recurring payments FAQ
faq.sub: Answers about recurring donation management and recurring payment gateway integration.

items.question: What are recurring payments?
items.answer: Recurring payments are contributions collected regularly on a schedule, for example a monthly donation, an annual membership fee or a monthly sponsorship. The supporter authorises the payment once, and it is then collected according to the agreed schedule.

items.question: How do recurring donations work in Donorfit?
items.answer: A supporter chooses a recurring contribution option where your setup offers one, selects the interval and authorises the payment with your payment provider. Donorfit supports monthly and annual giving with automated collection, and the provider processes each payment according to its schedule and authorisation rules.

items.question: Can organisations accept monthly donations?
items.answer: Yes, where your Donorfit setup and payment provider support recurring payments. Donorfit supports monthly and annual giving with automated collection.

items.question: Which payment gateways support recurring payments?
items.answer: On its Donorfit integration page, GoCardless explicitly lists one-off and recurring payments by direct debit. Stripe, PayPal, Mollie and Micropayment are also integrated, but recurring payments are not documented on their Donorfit integration pages, so please confirm availability for your account with our team.

items.question: Can members make recurring membership contributions?
items.answer: Yes. Donorfit Membership collects dues through recurring billing, including SEPA Direct Debit mandates and card billing, with renewal reminders and confirmation notices.

items.question: Can supporters change or cancel recurring payments?
items.answer: Members can manage their status and update their details in the self-service portal, and renewal workflows include payment method updates. For other recurring contributions, how changes and cancellations are handled depends on your Donorfit setup and payment provider. Please contact our team for the options available to you.

items.question: What happens if a recurring payment fails?
items.answer: In Membership and Sponsorship, failed payments are retried automatically, and sponsors are reminded before their payment details expire. Missed payments are visible on each sponsorship, so your team can follow up.

items.question: Are recurring payments available in every country?
items.answer: No. Recurring payments depend on the payment provider, the payment method and your account configuration, and each provider decides in which countries it operates. For example, SEPA Direct Debit is used in the SEPA area and Bacs Direct Debit in the UK.

items.question: Are recurring payment transaction fees included in Donorfit?
items.answer: No. Donorfit is free to use, and payment provider charges are separate. Your provider sets the transaction fees for each payment, including recurring payments, under your agreement with them.

items.question: How can an organisation enable recurring payments?
items.answer: Connect a payment provider that supports recurring payments for your account, then set up recurring options in Donorfit, for example membership plans with a renewal cycle or recurring giving. Our team can help you check which setup fits your organisation.
